item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00605","case1_error":"Treats 15 training days per stage as 15 weeks, omitting division by five training days per week.","case2_error":"Uses four 30-minute intervals per hour instead of two, doubling the article count.","reason":"Both use an erroneous time-unit conversion relation, rather than incorrectly evaluating a correctly written expression.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J00606","case1_error":"Adds 12 to depth even though being 12 feet higher requires subtracting 12.","case2_error":"Counts only one three-second elevator stop despite the specified stop on every floor.","reason":"The first reverses a directional relationship; the second omits repeated stop durations.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00607","case1_error":"Counts two houses instead of Zion's house plus his two friends' houses; equal house areas are also unstated.","case2_error":"Applies one-gallon capacity to all paint, ignoring the three-gallon white-paint cans.","reason":"The first omits a member of the requested group; the second applies one category's conversion factor to another category.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00608","case1_error":"Uses one bottle's 80-load capacity as the combined capacity of two bottles.","case2_error":"Reports soda consumed and given away as soda remaining, without subtracting it from the initial three bottles.","reason":"The first fails to scale capacity by bottle count; the second substitutes the removed quantity for the remaining quantity.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00609","case1_error":"Counts the two parent lambs again even though they are already included in the original six.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the correctly written sum 132 + 35 as 144 instead of 167.","reason":"The first double-counts an existing subset; the second makes a numerical evaluation error in a correct expression.","judgment":"different"}]}
